info.title: Atlas Migrate · api-gateway
info.description: HTTP contract for the gateway's locally-served endpoints (everything not routed to a downstream service). Hand-curated mirror of the controller annotations; refresh by booting the gateway and `curl /v3/api-docs > frontend/openapi/gateway.json` (see docs/api-contracts.md).

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Identity + auth-config probes used by the SPA

get.description: Returns the metadata the SPA needs before it has a token: where to redirect for login, the audience the JWT must carry, where to do RP-initiated logout, where the tracing UI lives. Public — no bearer required.
Identity derived from the validated JWT. Requires a bearer token; returns 401 otherwise. The `demo` flag mirrors the JWT's `atlas_demo` claim and drives the "DEMO IDENTITY" banner in the chrome.

bearer-jwt.description: Gateway-validated OIDC bearer token. See docs/auth.md.

mode.description: `sim` activates the local fake-IdP; `real` uses the customer's OIDC.

clientId.description: OAuth2 client id Atlas registers as.

audience.description: Audience the JWT must carry; informational for SDK consumers — gateway enforces server-side.

endSessionUrl.description: OIDC end_session_endpoint. Empty disables RP-initiated logout (SPA stays on local-only logout).

traceUiUrl.description: Base URL of the distributed-tracing UI (Jaeger / Tempo). Empty hides the "View trace" link in the audit browser.

role.description: Primary role, lowercased. Convenience field; `roles` is authoritative.

roles.description: All role claims from the JWT.

demo.description: True when the JWT carries `atlas_demo: true` (fake-IdP). Drives the demo banner in the SPA chrome.
